# Sadath Company

> UK studio building websites, e-commerce stores, custom software, and internal systems for startups and small businesses.

The Sadath Company Ltd is a UK-registered digital studio (England & Wales, Company No. 16707212). We work with startups and small-to-medium businesses on websites, online stores, custom software (dashboards, booking, portals), and systems work (workflow automation, integrations). Indicative packages are published; every engagement is governed by a bespoke Statement of Work.
